batch.title: Ticketing and admissions
batch.goal: Complete ticketing setup, inventory, holds, guest lists, credentials, devices, webhooks, admissions, reconciliation, and delivery.
exitCriteria: Ticketing producer-to-recipient and admissions journeys pass using canonical event identities.
Inventory, credential, device, webhook, offline, duplicate, isolation, and reconciliation cases pass.

specTasks.title: Ticketing
acceptanceCriteria: July 2026 ticketing foundation as the sole destination model; legacy read/write cutoff and migration policy

specTasks.title: Approve canonical ticketing ADR
acceptanceCriteria: Destination tables, inventory ledger, external provider boundary, cutover, refunds, capacity source, and retention are decided.

specTasks.title: Inventory legacy/new data and consumers
acceptanceCriteria: Tables/routes/pages/jobs/webhooks/reports map to destination, compatibility period, reconciliation query, and retirement milestone.

specTasks.title: Drop permissive legacy policies
acceptanceCriteria: Explicit migration drops blanket policies; direct Org A/Org B tests prove parent and record-ID isolation before UI rollout.

specTasks.title: Harden new ticketing RLS/functions
acceptanceCriteria: Event/org/grant checks cover config, inventory, customer/order protected data, ticket, credential, transfer, check-in, allocation, reservation, webhook, and analytics records.

specTasks.title: Add canonical service/command layer
acceptanceCriteria: Per-command schemas, capability, parent state, idempotency, inventory transaction, reason, audit, and typed errors are mandatory.

specTasks.title: Feature-flag Admin read model
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can compare legacy/new totals per organization/event; mismatch dashboard blocks cutover and exposes causes.

specTasks.title: Remove default capacities
acceptanceCriteria: Event builder requires explicit ticket setup or “not ticketed”; no GA/VIP records/quantities are silently created.

specTasks.title: Build event ticketing setup
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized user configures capacity source, currency, windows, tax/fee, ticket types/tiers/channels/limits and previews availability.

specTasks.title: Implement inventory ledger
acceptanceCriteria: Every inventory movement is atomic, balanced, attributable, idempotent, and reconstructs current availability; race tests prevent oversell.

specTasks.title: Build allocations/holds matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Tour × stop × allocation category shows requested/held/issued/released/used; deadlines and release rules are configurable/audited.

specTasks.title: Build comp/guest approval
acceptanceCriteria: Requests, approver threshold, recipient/host, credential, plus-one, notes, issuance, cancellation, and attendance are tracked.

specTasks.title: Rebuild campaigns/promos
acceptanceCriteria: Scope, eligibility, code generation/import, windows, limits, discount rule, budget/approval, redemption, fraud controls, and analytics use canonical data.

specTasks.title: Add order/ticket operations
acceptanceCriteria: Search is org/event scoped and rate-limited; resend/transfer/void/refund require allowed state/capability/reason and show financial impact.

specTasks.title: Add tour ticketing workspace
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized aggregate shows inventory/allocation/sales/refunds/comps/check-in and exceptions by stop with drilldown; provider freshness is explicit.

specTasks.title: Harden credential generation
acceptanceCriteria: Signed/rotatable verification format avoids embedded sensitive data; revocation/key rotation and backward validity policy are tested.

specTasks.title: Build scanner/device management
acceptanceCriteria: Register/revoke devices/operators, event packages, gates, last sync, version, and permissions; lost device can be invalidated.

specTasks.title: Add offline scanning
acceptanceCriteria: Package is event/audience scoped and expiring; duplicate/revoked/manual cases are clear; queued scans reconcile idempotently with conflict resolution.

specTasks.title: Build admissions dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Counts expose data freshness and offline devices; gate/type/time filters, anomaly alerts, and accessible manual fallback are supported.

specTasks.title: Build provider adapter/webhook boundary
acceptanceCriteria: Verify signature, replay/order/idempotency, map external identities/state, retain raw event securely, quarantine unmatched, and monitor lag/failure.

specTasks.title: Add ticket settlement handoff
acceptanceCriteria: Gross, fees, tax, refunds, chargebacks, comps, allocation, attendance and provider statements reconcile to finance/show settlement with variance.

specTasks.title: Migrate/reconcile legacy data
acceptanceCriteria: Per event/org counts and financial totals match approved tolerances; unresolved records are reviewed; legacy writes stop by feature flag.

specTasks.title: Ticketing security/load review
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover oversell races, IDOR, promo abuse, scanner forgery/replay, offline duplication, refund privilege, webhook attack, and high-volume scan/sale load.

specTasks.title: Retire old routes/tables/policies
acceptanceCriteria: Usage is zero, historical reads are preserved as approved, permissive policies are absent, and Admin UI/jobs/reports use canonical model only.

workflows.title: Ticketing, Guest Lists, Credentials, and Admissions

producer.outcome: Allocates, invites, transfers, or admits an event guest.

recipients.outcome: Receives and redeems a scoped, expiring ticket or guest-list credential.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Event and organization scope are revalidated for every allocation and token; credentials are hashed, expiring, and replay safe.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: The intended recipient can accept and use the credential once while outsiders are denied.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: events_v2, canonical tour access, and persisted plan/publication services
invariants: Legacy event identifiers are exposed only through the governed migration mapping.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Admin automated tests pass
launchGates.acceptance: All Admin suites pass with no unexplained skips.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.

launchGates.title: Canonical event lifecycle passes
launchGates.acceptance: Provider ingestion, events_v2, tour assignment, publication, calendar, and Artist delivery reconcile with zero unexplained delta.
